sentences.text:
.... For the appellants  1.
The present appeal has been filed challenging the judgement and order dated 26th June, 2025 passed by learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, 7th Court, Barasat, North 24 Parganas whereby the appellants have been convicted for the offence under Section 498A of Indian Penal Code and was awarded Simple Imprisonment for a term of two years.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, 7th Court, Barasat, North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appeal is in time and is in proper form.
2. In view of the ground explained the appeal is admitted.
3. The appellants were admitted the bail by the learned Trial Court.

The appellants were on bail during the period on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 10,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each, one of whom must be local to the satisfaction of the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, 7th Court, Barasat District North 24 Parganas till disposal of the appeal subject to the condition that the appellant shall award as amended.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, 7th Court, Barasat District North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Issue notice to the office of the Public Prosecutor.

5. Let the trial court record be called.
6.
Department is directed to prepare requisite number of paper books immediately after receipt of the trial court records.
7. All parties shall act in terms of sever copy of the order duly downloaded from the official website of this court.
8. Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requite formalities.
